description: This Java source file implements the ShareAccountReadPlatformService interface for reading share account data in the Fineract microfinance platform. It provides methods to retrieve share account templates, individual share account details, lists of accounts, and associated dividends. The class manages complex JDBC queries and data mapping to assemble comprehensive share account data objects, integrating data from multiple sources and services.

classes.name: ShareAccountReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the ShareAccountReadPlatformService interface to access and map share account data from database and services.

classes.name: ShareAccountMapper
classes.description: Inner class that maps JDBC ResultSet rows to ShareAccountData objects, building the main account details along with associated charges and transactions.

classes.name: ShareAccountMapperForDividents
classes.description: Inner class that maps ResultSet rows to ShareAccountData with associated dividend details for dividend-related queries.

classes.name: PurchasedSharesDataRowMapper
classes.description: Inner class that maps rows to ShareAccountTransactionData objects representing purchased shares.

classes.name: ShareAccountDividendRowMapper
classes.description: Inner class that maps rows to ShareAccountDividendData objects for dividend payout details.

methods.name: retrieveTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves a share account template for a given client and optionally a product, including available products, charges, and client savings accounts.

methods.name: deriveMarketPrice
methods.description: Calculates the current market price of a share based on the latest available market data and the current date.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information of a specific share account by ID, including current market price and dividends if requested.

methods.name: retrieveAssociatedDividends
methods.description: Helper method to fetch dividends associated with a share account.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all active share accounts.

methods.name: getResponseDataParams
methods.description: Returns the set of response parameters supported by the service.

methods.name: retrieveAllShareAccountDataForDividends
methods.description: Retrieves all share accounts related to a product for dividend processing, with optional inclusion of inActive accounts and date filtering.

methods.name: convertChargesToShareAccountCharges
methods.description: Converts a collection of ChargeData objects to ShareAccountChargeData objects for association with share accounts.

methods.name: retrieveAccountNumberByAccountId
methods.description: Fetches the account number of a share account given its ID.
